'u':['urban','useful','upright','ultimate','united','upbeat','unique','usual','utopian','urgent'],
'v':['vivid','vast','vital','valiant','velvet','varied','valid','verdant','vocal','virtuous'],
'w':['warm','wise','wide','welcome','witty','whole','wild','worthy','winsome','wonderful'],
'x':['xenial','xeric','xanthic','xylonic','xenodochial'],
'y':['young','yellow','yielding','yearly','yonder','youthful','yummy','yeomanly','yare','yugen'],
'z':['zesty','zero','zonal','zealous','zenithal','zippy','zany','zestful','zigzag','zymotic'],
}

def letter_count(s):
    h=hashlib.sha1(s.encode()).hexdigest()
    return sum(c in 'abcdef' for c in h), h

# Try deterministic/random combinations. Use optional punctuation/capitalization? keep simple lowercase words.
random.seed()
tries=0
for _ in range(2000000):

    n=random.choice(list(range(6,27)))
